dispute_ticket.description: I asked for the PIE and he went via the ECP instead, about 3 km longer, and I was charged S$24.60 against S$22.90 quoted. Please refund the S$1.70. Throughout the ride he kept asking how old I am, whether I have a boyfriend, and said girls my age should not wear skirts that short to work. I told him it was none of his business and he laughed.

chat_logs.content: Here we are, have a good day.

app_events.details: Quoted S$22.90 for estimated 17.9 km via PIE.
Trip completed; fare S$24.60; GPS route via ECP, 20.6 km.

fare_basis.value: metered fare that varies with distance and time
fare_basis.text: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare that varies with distance and time.

route_deviation_threshold_km.text: Governs route disputes. A deviation of more than this many km from the recommended route, without a notified reason, may be refundable.

personal_approaches_prohibited.text: Governs a driver's or rider's personal approaches to the other party. A true value means pressing the other party for contact details, personal invitations, gifts or remarks about their body or private life are not allowed on a Ryde trip.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The route claim looks ordinary (20.6 km travelled against 17.9 km quoted via PIE; the chat lines at 07:43:50 and 08:15:10 are innocent and show no notice of the ECP change). The chat does not show the conduct, but the complaint says that throughout the ride the driver asked her age and whether she has a boyfriend and commented on her skirt, and laughed when she told him it was none of his business. Unwanted personal questions and remarks about clothing by the driver are a safety matter that v2.1 s5.2 sends to a person, so no automated verdict or refund on the S$1.70.
